data.name: Noufal
data.gender_notes: Noufal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘an-Nafal’, meaning 'to rain down, to pour, to flood'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name Noufal was given to Prophet Ibrahim’s son Ismail when God promised him that his descendants would flood the land with numerous progeny. The name Noufal carries the meaning “Flooded” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noufal usually hope their child will grow to embody flooded and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes divine blessings and abundant growth.
data.etymology: Noufal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flooded.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noufal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نوفل
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوفل من أسماءِ البناتِ المُبارَكَةِ في الإسلامِ، ومعناهُ المُحِبُّ الخَيرِ الحَميدِ المُستَفيضُ، وقد يُتَوَلَّدُ لِأَبٍِ مِنَ السادةِ، أو لِأُمٍ مِنَ الأَمرَأةِ المُتَقَدِّمَةِ في الخَيرِ، وهوَ في الثَقافَةِ الإسلامِيَّةِ مُرمَقُ بالعَظَمَةِ وَالجَلالَةِ

in_urdu.name: نوفل
in_urdu.meaning: خیروں کا محبت کرنے والا اچھا، بڑا ہی عظیم، خوشحال
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوفل نام کا مطلب ہے خیروں کا محبت کرنے والا اچھا، بڑا ہی عظیم، خوشحال، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاصا مقبول ہے، بچوں کے لیے بہت ہی اچھا نام ہے، اس نام کا انتخاب کرنے سے بچے کے لیے خوشنسی کا ماحول پیدا ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: नौफल
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदर, अच्छा, बड़ा ही महान, खुशहाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: नौफल नाम का अर्थ है सुंदर, अच्छा, बड़ा ही महान, खुशहाल, यह नाम मुसलमानों में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है, बच्चों के लिए बहुत ही अच्छा नाम है, इस नाम का चयन करने से बच्चे के लिए खुशहाली का माहौल बनता है, इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामिक परंपरा में बहुत ही महत्वपूर्ण है

in_pashto.name: نوفل
in_pashto.meaning: خیروں کا محبت کرنے والا، ښه، څرنگه، خوشحال
in_pashto.long_meaning: نوفل نوم څخه ښه، څرنگه، خوشحال، خیروں کا محبت کرنے والا، دا نوم مسلمانو څخه ګډه کړی نوم دی، دا نوم مسلمانو کولای کړی، نوښې کړی، دا نوم په افغانستان کې خورا لوړ مقام لري

in_english.name: Noufal
in_english.meaning: Lover of good, generous, big, and happy, beautiful soul, one of the names of the beloved
in_english.long_meaning: Noufal is an Arabic name meaning lover of good, generous, big, and happy, beautiful soul. It is one of the names of the beloved in Islamic tradition. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-f' which means 'to increase' or 'to be abundant'. In Islamic theology, the name Noufal is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's attribute of being generous and kind. The name is highly revered in Islamic culture and is often given to children born into Muslim families

Noufal serves as a reminder of endless Divine love, mercy, and generosity.
